description: A candidate who certified under the qualification Plumbing and Heating (WorldSkills) is primarily responsible for installation, repair and maintenance of plumbing and heating systems in residential, commercial and industrial settings. The technician will play a crucial role in ensuring the proper functioning of water supply, drainage, gas, heating, dry wall systems, pump operations etc. and contributing to the overall comfort and safety of occupants.
awardingBodyName: WATER MANAGEMENT AND PLUMBING SKILL COUNCIL
